title: On the irrationality measure of log 3
relevant_concepts: linear independence measure of 1, log 2, log 3
notes: Journal of Number Theory 142 (2014) 264-273. Effective measure |a + b log 2 + c log 3| >= H^{-4.1163051-epsilon} with H = max(|b|,|c|), hence mu(log 3) <= 5.1163051. Improves Rhin 1987 (8.616) and Salikhov 2007 (5.125). Implies a polynomial bound a_{j+1} << q_j^{3.1163+epsilon} on partial quotients of log 2/log 3, not a_{j+1}=O(1). Does not kill Juggler survivor fans (those sit at the exceptional approximants any such theorem must allow) and is not a Baker-transfer reopen; docs/problems/juggler_cycle_gap_baker.md stays REFUTED. Attack C packages the transfer as a fan-width theorem: docs/problems/juggler_cycle_walk_fan_growth.md. Attack B (archimedean / p-adic coupling) is CLOSED: this two-logarithm measure does not produce a 2-adic/3-adic coupling quantity; docs/problems/juggler_cycle_padic_coupling.md. Also literature context for the fan-multipoint attack (A).
